home_legend: alpha and beta: a project (a git repository with a remote); global: written outside any repository; null: no homes row
lines: a line with 'store' runs one query on that store (a 'stores' entry: its tables' rows and the SQL applied after them) with the filters, pool size and result width it names; its pool is row numbers, each hit [id, bits, raw_bits, relevance, match_terms]; avgdl is IEEE-754 bits
runs: offline: no admission; '<caller>/<surface>': the caller's admission on that surface. pool: the candidate ids in pool order (FTS5 rank through the admission); hits: ranked; stats: each call of the pool's statistics, [terms, size, body_df, scope_df, avgdl] or [terms, null].

    body_fts, scopes_fts,
    content='memories', content_rowid='rowid',

)
INSERT INTO "memories_fts"("memories_fts") VALUES ('rebuild')

CREATE TRIGGER memories_ai AFTER INSERT ON memories BEGIN
    INSERT INTO memories_fts(rowid, body_fts, scopes_fts)
    VALUES (new.rowid, new.body_fts, new.scopes_fts);
END

CREATE TRIGGER memories_ad AFTER DELETE ON memories BEGIN
    INSERT INTO memories_fts(memories_fts, rowid, body_fts, scopes_fts)
    VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.body_fts, old.scopes_fts);
END

END
